Early notes: 6 accounts in a 22-minute window, same IPv4 /24 block, same X-Forwarded-For pattern, and three accounts used the same recovery phone and similar disposable-email providers. Payment-info was not provided (self-serve free grant flow). The risk signals triggered are our 'duplicate identity + device-cluster' rule which auto-holds promo issuance.

Recommendation: hold automated promo issuance for that batch pending manual verification. We can do a targeted manual grant if SupportFlow provides a single org-level verification (work email list or SSO proof).
